Start with res = []. Iterating over the UTF-8 encoding of 'os||agx5' gives ch values 111, 115, 124, 124, 97, 103, 120, 53. None is 61 or 0, so every iteration reaches the append. Formatting each ch with '; ' and encoding it appends, in order: b'111; ', b'115; ', b'124; ', b'124; ', b'97; ', b'103; ', b'120; ', b'53; '. The empty bytes separator joins these pieces without changing the trailing space.
Final answer: b'111; 115; 124; 124; 97; 103; 120; 53; '
